leadText: Oleana's subordinate (Japanese: オリーヴの部下 Olive's subordinate) is a Macro Cosmos who works under Oleana.
plainText:
Oleana's subordinate (Japanese: オリーヴの部下 Olive's subordinate) is a Macro Cosmos who works under Oleana.

==In animation==
===History===
Oleana's subordinate is a recurring character in . He debuted at the end of Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald!, where he was following Goh and Sonia's car.

In Sword and Shield: The Darkest Day!, he continued to follow Goh and Sonia as they visited the geoglyph on the hill outside Turffield, as well as Professor Magnolia at her laboratory in Wedgehurst. After speaking to Oleana, he confronted the pair at Stow-on-Side while they were visiting the ancient mural and sent out his Gigantamax . Goh Dynamaxed his and proceeded to battle Garbodor, accidentally destroying the mural in the process.

In Sword and Shield: "From Here to Eternatus!", Goh and Raboot managed to defeat his Garbodor despite its Gigantamax form. He retreated to get aid from other , only for Raboot to kick them all aside to allow Goh and Sonia to escape. He and the other employees later confronted Sonia in front of the Hammerlocke Stadium, only for Raihan to appear to defend her. In the next episode, he and the other employees were easily defeated by Raihan's , forcing them to withdraw.
